problem: AVI ADPCM framing equates physical chunks with fixed-size samples. Legal chunks grouping multiple blocks are refused because dwLength counts blocks,not chunk headers.

references.finding: A nonzero dwSampleSize permits grouping samples in one chunk;audio uses nBlockAlign. Rate/scale and dwLength refer to stream samples.
An AVI ADPCM stream sample is one compressed block rather than one decoded PCM sample. End position lies after all rendered data.

fixture_scope: 14 grouped fixed-size IMA/MS cases:10 mono2+1/1+2/3/nested/indexed plus4 stereo3/indexed. Four mono/stereo single-block controls and4 malformed controls. Block bytes8/16,sample size8/16,declared3 blocks;opposite-channel literal stereo PCM.
requirements: Confirm source admission fails specifically at treating dwLength3 as a raw chunk count. Generic parser must already preserve raw chunks,index addresses and every compressed byte.
Expose each whole ADPCM block as a logical packet with original per-block clock,independent predictor decode,rewind,block-rounded seek and exact EOF.
Keep the original raw-chunk view for container/index consistency and G.711. Do not feed several blocks as if one packet duration.
Check expanded logical packet count against Limits.records before allocating its block view. Keep complete blocks only and retain declared block-count refusal.
Validate exact literal PCM,encoded packet clocks,actual mid-block requested seek with block-rounded landing,EOF and resource limits. Ordinary tests remain offline and do not generate fixtures.
implementation_plan: A private optional Vec<Record> maps grouped chunks to independently coded blocks. Count/validate whole blocks with a preallocation budget check;the one-block common path and G.711 retain their existing record view. No public API or performance claim.

test_oracle_repair.finding: The initial worker oracle incorrectly clipped a mid-block seek to1.25ms;the source contract explicitly returns the preceding block at1.125ms. Fix only the expected packet list and assert the rounded return. No production seek change or additional improvement ID.
test_oracle_repair.scope: The baseline malformed controls currently only show refusal within the restricted profile,which can precede their intended partial-block/count contradiction. After enabling grouped framing,the test must assert the precise incomplete-block or wrong-block-count error.

counting: One grouped fixed-block AVI ADPCM capability. No separate IDs for grouping,IMA/MS,nested/indexed layout,seek,clock/resource support,test repair or samples.
